<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">9:41</text>
    <rect x="334" y="17" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
    <rect x="339" y="14" width="3" height="10" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
    <rect x="344" y="11" width="3" height="13" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="22" x2="362" y2="18" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="362" y1="18" x2="366" y2="22" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="362" cy="23" r="1.5" fill="#333333"/>
    <rect x="372" y="14" width="16" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="388" y="17" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
    <rect x="374" y="16" width="11" height="6" rx="1" fill="#F5C418"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="91" r="29" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="195" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">IMDb</text>
    <text x="195" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Welcome back</text>
    <text x="195" y="177" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Sign in to continue to your account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Sign-in form -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="220" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Email address</text>
    <rect x="28" y="230" width="334" height="52" rx="8" fill="#F2F2F2" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="45" y="262" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">alex.morgan@email.com</text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="256" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="336,256 339,259 344,253" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <text x="28" y="319" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Password</text>
    <rect x="28" y="329" width="334" height="52" rx="8" fill="#F2F2F2" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="45" y="361" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">••••••••••••</text>
    <circle cx="337" cy="353" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="348" x2="342" y2="358" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="348" x2="332" y2="358" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <rect x="28" y="405" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="#F5C418" stroke="#F5C418" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="32,414 36,418 42,410" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="56" y="419" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Remember me</text>
    <text x="362" y="419" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#F5C418">Forgot password?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="458" width="334" height="50" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="28" y="456" width="334" height="50" rx="8" fill="#F5C418"/>
      <text x="195" y="487" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Sign in</text>
    </g>
    <line x1="28" y1="548" x2="166" y2="548" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="548" x2="362" y2="548" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="553" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">or</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="28" y="577" width="334" height="50" rx="8" fill="#333333"/>
      <text x="195" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Create account</text>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="665" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">By continuing, you agree to the terms and privacy policy.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom light navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,795 49,787 59,795" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="42" y="794" width="14" height="11" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="49" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Search -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="136" cy="796" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="141" y1="801" x2="147" y2="807" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="136" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Wishlist -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="215,790 219,797 227,798 221,803 223,811 215,807 208,811 209,803 203,798 211,797" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="215" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Profile active -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="322" cy="795" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#F5C418" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="322" cy="807" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#F5C418" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="322" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#F5C418">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
